model_annotation: This plot illustrates the performance of several models over a series of iterations. The x-axis is labeled "#Iteration" and represents a linear scale ranging from 0 to 140000, with tick labels at every 20000 units. The y-axis is labeled "Loss" and represents a linear scale ranging from 2.4 to 3.4, with tick labels at every 0.1 units. A purple, solid line, labeled "Vanilla," begins at a value of approximately 2.99 at iteration 0 and gradually decreases to approximately 2.42 at iteration 140000. A blue, solid line, labeled "StrmLLM," starts at approximately 2.96 at iteration 0 and decreases to approximately 2.41 at iteration 140000. A red, solid line, labeled "SepLLM (n=64)," begins at approximately 2.97 at iteration 0 and decreases to approximately 2.41 at iteration 140000. A green, solid line, labeled "SepLLM (n=64, H)," starts at approximately 2.96 at iteration 0 and decreases to approximately 2.41 at iteration 140000. A magenta, solid line, labeled "SepLLM (n=64, H/T)," begins at approximately 2.96 at iteration 0 and decreases to approximately 2.41 at iteration 140000. An orange, solid line, labeled "SepLLM (n=64, H, T)," starts at approximately 2.96 at iteration 0 and decreases to approximately 2.41 at iteration 140000.
